component.name: termvisor
component.summary: Terminal for SSH, serial ports and embedded work

description.p: termvisor puts the connections of embedded and network work into one window with tabs and split panes: local shells, SSH, mosh, serial ports, raw TCP, telnet, FTP and Android devices.

ul.li: Serial ports with locking, mirrors, hex and MAVLink views, XMODEM, YMODEM and ZMODEM
SFTP and FTP file panel with a transfer queue and resume
Command buttons, macros with expect, multi-exec to several panes
Live multichannel plot of values a device prints
Timestamps, regex highlighting and logging in every pane
SSH tunnels, TFTP and HTTP servers, port scanner, ping graph, Wake-on-LAN
Passive USB capture with decoders for USB serial adapters, HID and mass storage
adb shell, logcat and device files
Themes with an editor, remappable shortcuts and a command palette

screenshot.caption: Serial console with highlighting, timestamps and command buttons
Live plot of four channels above a serial pane
Decoded USB capture of a serial adapter
Logcat view and Android device list
Ping tool with a round trip graph

description.p: One-click update on Windows, an About window, removing entries from Recent, a Plot button in every pane and clearer toolbar buttons.
Windows serial ports: DTR and RTS are set on connect, and typed text no longer waits up to half a second. Checks for a new release on every start.
Windows: a portable single exe that runs without installing, and the program icon and version in the exe.
Windows installer with upgrade support. Checks for new releases once a day. On Windows, background programs such as adb and ssh no longer open console windows.
Windows support: a portable terminal view replaces VTE, local shells run on ConPTY, passwords are kept in Windows Credential Manager. Windows builds ship as a zip with the GTK runtime.
